verdict.rationale: Skills only runs inside Anthropic-hosted surfaces (Claude Code, Claude.ai, Claude API/container execution environment); nothing in the evidence describes running the Skills execution environment or Claude itself on infrastructure the user controls. The 'open standard' language (agentskills.io) refers to file format portability across tools, not to self-hosting Anthropic's own product. Missing for 10: any documentation of a self-hosted/on-prem deployment option, self-managed execution runtime, or independent report of someone running Skills outside Anthropic's cloud.
